snippet.title: SEDAP! A Culinary Adventure | Official Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
𝗦𝗘𝗗𝗔𝗣! 𝗔 𝗖𝘂𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗔𝗱𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗼𝗹𝗲𝘀!

Southeast Asian cooking game SEDAP! is coming to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch on October 22, 2025.

SEDAP! A Culinary Adventure is a co-op cooking-combat adventure that combines the chaos of a collaborative kitchen and the wonders of adventuring into an unexplored world. Embark on an exciting culinary journey, whip up delectable delicacies, and serve your way through a fantastical reimagination of Southeast Asia!

𝗦𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗘 𝗣𝗔𝗚𝗘𝗦

🔵 PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10014108
🟢 Xbox: https://xbox.com/en-US/games/store/sedap-a-culinary-adventure/9NKKSVBNVJKL
🔴 Nintendo Switch: https://nintendo.com/us/store/products/sedap-a-culinary-adventure-switch/

#PS5 #XboxSeriesXS #NintendoSwitch
